title: Screen List
description: Ordered list of routes to scaffold. Each route declares its layout role, complexity, primary regions, agent involvement, and required mock entities. Compound screens additionally declare their sub-component children. Produced by a Beat 1 agent from the PRD's core screens + lo-fi concepts.json; consumed by `scaffold-routes`, `scaffold-compound`, and `bundle-context`.

path.description: Next.js route path. Dynamic segments use [param] syntax.

intent.description: One-line description of what this screen does for the primary persona.

layout.description: Layout role. Determines TopNav composition and PageContainer size.

breadcrumb.description: Crumb labels for editor routes (used when topNavRoles[layout].center === 'breadcrumb').

complexity.description: `simple` = one body agent. `compound` = pre-authored composition shell + N parallel sub-component agents.

trivial.description: Set true for redirects and < 20-line index pages. Main thread writes these directly instead of spawning an agent.

redirectTo.description: Required when trivial=true AND the route is a redirect.

primaryRegions.description: Region kinds present on this screen. Used by `smoke.mjs` for per-route Playwright assertions and by `bundle-context` to bias the agent prompt.

agentInvolvement.description: How AI/agent features appear on this screen.

requiredMockEntities.description: Names of mock-contract entities this screen depends on. Validated against mock-contract.json.

edgeCaseStates.description: PRD-derived edge-case states this screen exposes via ?state=<name>.

urlParams.description: Named URL params this screen reads to drive overlay/sub-component visibility.

compound.description: Required when complexity='compound'. Declares the sub-component children that scaffold-compound emits and that parallel sub-component agents fill.

name.description: PascalCase component name. Becomes the import + file _kebab-case.tsx.

propContract.description: Free-form description of the props the shell will pass. Agent uses this to type the component's props.

approximateLoc.description: Rough LOC budget for this sub-component. Used by the SLOWDOWN-DIAGNOSIS heuristic.

visibilityCondition.description: When this sub-component renders. E.g. "always", "when ?panel=<id>", "when openConflictCount > 0".
